scope: Pinned inventory of all concrete model-serving Compose services, model-specific launchers, runbook launch blocks and prose-only Qwen3.8 profiles in the LIL recipe trees. The vLLM dev/jovian-judgement and SGLang main root launchers are included. Generic engine examples, build/benchmark helpers and topology-free catalog contracts are inventoried separately; incomplete public sources are explicitly unresolved.
